name: Resque Open-Source Redis Job Queue
free_limit: MIT-licensed Ruby Redis-backed background-job queue with worker processing, multiple queues and a web dashboard; no software license fee or vendor-imposed usage quota.
watch_out: Self-operated Ruby workers and Redis are required; compute, Redis hosting, persistence, monitoring and operations can incur costs. Redis distribution/version licensing and third-party integrations are separate. Current upstream docs require Ruby 3.2+ and Redis server 4.0+; no free managed queue is included.
